what: Gen Digital sells consumer security and identity protection software: Norton antivirus, Avast, LifeLock identity theft protection, and after buying MoneyLion, consumer financial products.
customers: Individual consumers and households worldwide, paying monthly or annual subscriptions.
money: Norton, Avast, Avira and LifeLock subscriptions
moat: Subscriptions that renew automatically with high retention, sold to a base of hundreds of millions of users assembled through decades of acquisitions.
risks: Debt of about $8 billion from acquisitions against little cash
Free security built into operating systems competes with paid antivirus
Consumer subscription growth is slow without acquisitions
opportunities: Revenue grew about 27% last year with a 42% operating margin
Gross margin of 78% and very high subscription renewal rates
MoneyLion extends it into consumer finance, a bigger spending category
watch: Direct customer count and bookings growth excluding acquisitions.
